subject: GCP commitment: closure schedule, MAP and billing orchestration
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@medisys.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: GCP commitment: closure schedule, MAP and billing orchestration

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to share a concise mutual action plan (attached) and a proposed closure schedule that aligns the GCP private offer milestone with your procurement windows and invoicing cadence. Key asks up front:

- Confirm target PO date (we proposed 2026-11-20).
- Confirm whether Medisys requires vendor invoice to go to central finance or individual BU (attachment shows both flows).
- Any SOC2 / vendor attestation docs still outstanding?

I've attached med-specified MAP v3 and a short diagram of the billing orchestration (invoice-routing-diagram.png). Karthik and Marcus are looped in for pricing finalization and billing setup.

If that timeline works, we'll send the DocuSign PO and begin the private offer configuration on GCP side (reduces provisioning time by ~5 business days).

Best,
Laura
Director, GTM — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: medisys_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP workbook), gcp_private_offer_instructions.pdf (setup checklist), invoice-routing-diagram.png (flow)

From: Priya Rao <priya@medisys.health>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medisys Procurement <procurement@medisys.health>, Anil Desai <anil.desai@medisys.health>
Date: 2026-11-08T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP commitment: closure schedule, MAP and billing orchestration

Laura —

Thanks for the MAP and the diagrams. Quick answers:

- Target PO date: we are aiming for 2026-11-22 (end of our current sprint) but can move earlier if vendor paperwork is complete.
- Billing: central finance requires vendor invoices against the PO number. Prefer PDF invoices to finance@medisys.health with PO number in subject.
- Compliance: we still need a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a data flow diagram specific to the hosted service.

Two questions from procurement:
1) Can Redwood accept net-60 terms for the first three months and then move to net-30?
2) For the GCP private offer, will the invoice be issued by Redwood or by your GCP partner? We need that detail to route it properly.

I've attached our standard vendor addendum; legal will review the redlines once we confirm billing party.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager — Medisys Health
procurement@medisys.health

Attachment: Medisys_Vendor_Addendum_v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@medisys.health>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP commitment: closure schedule, MAP and billing orchestration

Priya —

Thanks for the quick follow. Short answers:

1) Net terms: We can accommodate net-60 for the initial 90-day onboarding period with a written note in the SOW; after that we default to net-30. I'll have finance draft the language and share.

2) Invoice party: Redwood will issue the invoice. The GCP private offer billing will be routed through our reseller arrangement, but Redwood will generate and own the customer invoice (we'll include the GCP usage line items for clarity). That means invoices go to finance@medisys.health with the PO number in the subject.

Action items I will take:
- Draft net-60 language for the SOW by 2026-11-10 EOD.
- Share redacted SOC2 and a service-specific data flow diagram by 2026-11-10.
- Confirm the DocuSign PO flow once Laura confirms the final MAP dates.

Marcus — can you confirm the expected lead time on the private offer activation once DocuSign is signed?

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@medisys.health>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP commitment: closure schedule, MAP and billing orchestration

Hi Priya —

We can spin up the private offer configuration within 24 hours of the DocuSign-complete event if all account-level verifications are OK. Realistic timeline:

- DocuSign complete + PO received by finance: Day 0
- Private offer configuration + GCP partner confirmation: Day 0–1 (24 hours)
- Reserved SKU provisioning + test endpoint: Day 1–3
- Full routing and monitoring in prod: Day 4–6

Given your PO target of 2026-11-22, if we receive signed DocuSign and PO by 2026-11-20 COB, we will be live into production by ~2026-11-26. We will also label the initial invoices as "Onboarding" to make it clear for your central finance team.

I'll attach a one-page activation checklist to the Deal record and make sure the billing contact receives sample invoice PDF.

Next steps: Laura, if that timeline works for Medisys, please confirm and we'll push DocuSign. Priya, once legal confirms the addendum redlines are non-substantive, we can keep the 11/22 target.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation_checklist_onepager.pdf
